top_signals.title: China Services Gauge Unexpectedly Dips for First Time Since July
top_signals.summary: China’s services activity unexpectedly grew at a slower rate for the first time since July, a private survey showed, as business confidence eased and firms lowered their selling prices despite intensifying inflation in input costs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Midterm elections could jolt stocks as Democrats look poised to sweep Congress
top_signals.summary: Wall Street weighs how the 2026 midterms could affect stocks, Treasury yields, artificial intelligence, energy prices, banks, defense and healthcare.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
